title: India would have remained undivided, if first PM was Vallabbhai Patel: Rajasthan Minister Meena
description: KOTA (Rajasthan), Nov 24 : If Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel had been the country’s first prime minister instead of Jawaharlal Nehru, Pakistan would not have come into existence and Article 370 would not have been imposed, Rajasthan Agriculture Minister Kirodi Lal Meena said on Monday. He was speaking as the chief guest at the launch of the ‘Jago Jagao Ekta Yatra’ organised by Education and Panchayati Raj Minister Madan Dilawar on the occasion of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel’s 150th birth anniversary in […]

title: Volcano eruption: DGCA asks airlines to avoid volcanic ash-affected areas, altitudes
description: DGCA issued an urgent advisory to Indian airlines to avoid volcanic ash-affected areas and report any suspected ash encounters. The Hayli Gubbi volcano in Ethiopia erupted after 10,000 years, causing ash clouds to drift over Yemen, Oman, Pakistan, and parts of India. title: Why Pakistan Cannot Undermine Tejas Despite Its Desperate Global Campaign
description: Pakistan’s loud propaganda blitz after the Dubai Tejas crash may dominate online noise, but it collapses against decades of data, global interest and India’s expanding defence ecosystem, leaving Islamabad exposed as a desperate disruptor, not a credible voice in aviation today.
